title: Longshore
wikitext:
[[Image:Longshore.jpg|thumb|300px|Longshore]]

'''Longshore''' is the vast stretch of coastline along [[Westfall]]. Traveling along the coast can be hazardous as swarms of [[murloc]]s (including [[Old Murk-Eye]]) roam the beaches unchecked. Many shipwrecks, including elven destroyers, lie off the coast.

On the far southwestern coast is the farm of [[Daphne Stilwell]], who was attacked by members of the [[Defias Brotherhood]] until aspiring [[Knights of the Silver Hand]] sent by [[Duthorian Rall]] came to protect her.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|25|The Tome of Valor (3)|The Tome of Valor|class=paladin}}</ref><ref>{{questlong|Alliance|25|The Tome of Valor (4)|The Tome of Valor|class=paladin}}</ref> The Westfall Lighthouse is located off the far southern edge of Longshore.

The [[Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance]], which [[night elf]] [[druid]]s need to collect to learn [[Aquatic Form]], is stored in a [[Strange Lockbox]] near a shipwreck off northwestern Longshore.<ref>{{questlong|Both|25|Trial of the Sea Lion|class=druid}}</ref>
